# phosphor-certificate-manager / parse_cert_fuzzer

OSS-Fuzz's fuzz target `parse_cert_fuzzer` ([source](source/parse_cert_fuzzer.cpp), unmodified) over phosphor-certificate-manager (openbmc/phosphor-certificate-manager at 9d6ea17f).

parseCert(pem) then validateCertificateStartDate / validateCertificateInSSLContext / validateCertificateAgainstStore(empty store); every validation failure is reported by throwing (elog<InvalidCertificate>/InternalFailure) and both catch(std::exception) and catch(...) swallow it.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against phosphor-certificate-manager at commit 9d6ea17f.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.
